# cycloid_plugin_widget_views (Data Source)

List all widget views for an installed plugin.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plugin_install_id` (Number) The ID of the plugin install to list widget views for.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) The organization canonical, defaults to the provider `default_organization`.

### Read-Only

- `widget_views` (List of Object) List of widget views for the plugin install. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widget_views))

<a id="nestedatt--widget_views"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widget_views`

Read-Only:

- `effective_enabled` (Boolean)
- `effective_slug` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `has_override` (Boolean)
- `id` (Number)
- `is_inherited` (Boolean)
- `url_slug` (String)
